_comment: Copy to a1-config.json and edit. That file is per-host and is not committed.
Point source_clone and pytest_python at a DURABLE location, not a session scratchpad:
a frozen schedule is 38 model runs long, and a clone that moves turns the deny
withholding it into a deny that names nothing -- indistinguishable, in the artifact,
store_master is the frozen corpus, copied per arm-run and never opened by an arm.
corpus_digest is the row digest that corpus was registered with; when it is set the
runner refuses to start against any other store, and when it is empty the run says so.
